Cricket Captains Discuss Team Culture and Future SA20 Season

Pretoria Capitals captain Keshav Maharaj expressed optimism about building on his relationship with Sourav Ganguly for the SA20 season 5. Maharaj stated that Ganguly was instrumental in fostering a positive team culture. The captains are looking forward to developing their partnership in the upcoming season.
